question: Can one frozen relational verifier recover known SCAR candidates contributed by scientific SAE retrieval while separately measuring dense-hit retention?

scope.dataset: SCAR English bidirectional cross-domain retrieval proxy
scope.reason: The complete SCAR retrieval result and its rescue behavior have already been inspected.

development_population.retention_selection: SHA-256 order over dense-top-10 successes whose canonical pair is absent from the rescue stratum
development_population.use: outcome-stratified screening on a fully inspected development benchmark; no population Recall claim

candidate_generation.sae_union: stable deduplicated union of dense top-10, cs.LG SAE top-10, and astro.PH SAE top-10
candidate_generation.random_union: stable deduplicated union of dense top-10 and two independently seeded random-projection top-10 lists
candidate_generation.random_control_scope: matched on dictionary width, top-k sparsity, number of representations, and at-most-30 candidate budget; not claimed to match learned SAE activation statistics

feature_evidence.selection: highest aggregate IDF-weighted shared activation across every SAE-union query-candidate pair, without qrels
feature_evidence.coherence_rule: only descriptions returned coherent=true may be supplied
feature_evidence.direct_example_rule: omit the entire feature for a pair if either system's normalized name-plus-background content hash occurs anywhere in that feature's exact batched description-request context
feature_evidence.usable_features_per_pair: 0 to 3 after frozen coherence and direct-example filtering
feature_evidence.interpretation: the grounded comparison adds the full feature-evidence bundle (opaque aliases, activation percentiles, and descriptions), not descriptions alone

mechanism_extraction.pair_specific_breakpoints: produced only by the blinded verifier, never invented for one system in isolation

verifier.external_processing: extract and describe send SCAR names/backgrounds; verify sends derived graphs and eligible feature descriptions; explicit authorization is required
verifier.ranking_score: fixed deterministic function of integer rubric fields
verifier.batching: one immutable deterministic ordered/chunked superpool plan per query; identical candidates, aliases, and positions are scored once without and once with SAE evidence
verifier.missing_or_stale_result_policy: abort rather than silently bottom-rank or mix provenance

arms.dense30_structure: Dense top-30 ranked by the structure-only pair verifier
arms.sae_union_structure: Dense plus two-SAE union ranked by the exact same structure-only pair verifier
arms.random_union_structure: Dense plus two-random-sparse union ranked by the exact same structure-only pair verifier
arms.sae_union_feature_grounded: The exact SAE union and verifier augmented with the frozen coherent, direct-example-safe feature-evidence bundle

primary_diagnostics: SAE-union structure verifier minus dense-30 structure verifier
SAE-union structure verifier minus random-union structure verifier
feature-grounded SAE-union verifier minus structure-only SAE-union verifier
development_readout.uncertainty: separate canonical-pair clustered bootstraps within the rescue and retention strata
development_readout.interpretation: outcome-stratified exploratory method screening only; pooled screen rates are descriptive and no p-value or interval is confirmatory

stop_rules: Do not modify the frozen retrieval, Latent Escape, or Latent Choice protocols.
Do not expose qrels or rescue labels to extraction, feature description, or verification.
Do not tune on or reuse the 120 untouched Latent Choice prompts.
Dense and random arm ordering on the outcome-selected screen is diagnostic only and cannot establish SAE specificity.
Treat the feature-grounded minus structure-only comparison only as the effect of adding this SAE-derived feature-evidence bundle, separate from candidate-source value.
A passing screen licenses only method freezing and evaluation on an outcome-independent external benchmark.
Do not run a confirmatory analysis until the complete method and an independent benchmark are frozen.
